submission_policy: one direct submit RPC per signed tx_blob; no retries or output-derived setup

close_policy.setup: fund named accounts, then close before recording parent
close_policy.request: close at Env::now() plus five network seconds
close_policy.capture: requested time, parent time, sequence, pre-close flags, and open-ledger tx blobs

snapshot_policy: raw ledger header, effective rule IDs and names, fee schedule, raw SLE bytes, raw transaction and metadata bytes
batch_wrapper_policy: canonical RawTransaction and poisoned CreatedNode wrapper, on both fix sides where BatchV1_1 is enabled
rpc_boundary: submit response retained verbatim together with parsed TER token, numeric code, applied, queued, accepted, broadcast, kept, and fee fields
